messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server pre-installed on something like an Amazon EC2 AMI?
parts:
I haven't seen one yet. I hope these instructions are fairly straightforward though if you start with an Ubuntu 12.10 or 12.04 VM:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions

The only additional thing for EC2 would be to make sure the Security Group that the instance is assigned to allows incoming TCP traffic on port 3838. (Or really, use a custom /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf that uses port 80 instead, and make sure the Security Group allows that.)
